Good to know

Questions, answered.

Who can order?

Wapus contains alcohol (5% alc./vol.) and is for adults of legal drinking age only. Age is checked at delivery.

What size are the cans?

Every edition comes in a 440 ml can. Choose a single can, a 4-pack or a 12-pack, or the Collector’s box with one of each edition.

How is it delivered?

Orders ship in insulated packaging to stay cold. Delivery is free on orders above ₹1,999.

Are the prices final?

Prices shown are placeholders for this demo and will be updated before launch.
